name: PT Andalan Perkasa Abadi Tbk
summary: PT Andalan Perkasa Abadi Tbk is an Indonesian entity specializing in the development and management of real estate. Its property holdings primarily consist of apartments and villas. The company, which was initially founded in 2014 as PT Gatra Wibawa Sejati, adopted its present name, PT Andalan Perkasa Abadi Tbk, in 2016. Its corporate headquarters are located in Bali, Indonesia.
